kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

lines.say: Can't shake the fear tonight? Say this one with David.
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee. Psalm fifty six, verse three.
lines.big: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

lines.say: He didn't say if I'm afraid. He said what time. Fear comes. Trust answers it.
lines.big: He didn't say if I'm afraid. He said what time. Fear comes. Trust answers it.

lines.say: Lord, when I'm afraid, I'll trust in you. Tonight too. In Jesus' name, amen.
